messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?
A fair financial share, without subsidizing A’s purchase. Please tell them I haven’t agreed to a family discount. I’d like this settled, but there’s no real deadline.

My husband and I hope to buy the house, ideally at a family discount. I don’t know what price or shares would be fair yet, and I know C hasn’t agreed. I want both my sisters’ interests treated fairly.
Thank you. I don’t need the house itself, but some money to help me start a dance studio would mean a lot. I’m not sure what amount would be fair; I’d hope we’re treated fairly and evenly.
Yes, provided the valuation is independent and my share is fair. Please suggest how to set it up.
I’m open to an independent valuation, but I can’t yet agree to buy at full value or settle B’s share in cash before we know the valuation and everyone’s shares. Please suggest how to set it up.
That sounds fair in principle. I’d prefer a jointly agreed independent valuer, so the figure is clear to everyone.
I’m not sure what the will says or whether a solicitor is handling the estate. I’ll check.
I’m not sure what the will says or whether a solicitor is handling the estate. I’ll check.
I’m afraid I don’t know what the will says or whether a solicitor is handling the estate.
